definitions.gloss: to echo; to resound; to ring out across an area
definitions.explanation: A sound that carries and spreads throughout a wide area. The {渡|わた}る component adds the sense of the sound traveling across a space.

examples.english: The sound of the bell rang out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}った。

⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{鳴|な}き{声|ごえ}→鳴き声：16846_nakigoe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Birdsong echoed through the quiet mountains.

notes:
USAGE:
{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}る is a compound verb that emphasizes a sound spreading across a wide space. It is often used in literary or descriptive writing to create vivid auditory imagery.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{歓声|かんせい}→歓声：02686_kansei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}る (cheers ring out)
- ⟦{銃声|じゅうせい}→銃声：28328_juusei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}る (gunshots echo)
- ⟦{雷鳴|らいめい}→雷鳴：06188_raimei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}る (thunder reverberates)
- ⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{響|ひび}き{渡|わた}る (applause echoes)

FORMS:
Compound of ⟦{響|ひび}く→響く：00099_hibiku⟧ (to echo, to resound) + ⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧ (to cross over). The ～⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧ pattern indicates an action that extends across an entire area, as in ⟦{見渡|みわた}す→見渡す：07169_miwatasu⟧ (to look out over) or ⟦{行|い}き{渡|わた}る→行き渡る：07003_ikiwataru⟧ (to spread throughout).
